title: Code Map Builder
subtitle: Builds and maintains the dependency map: calls, imports, implementations, references, definitions and re-exports.
lede: Builds and maintains the dependency map: calls, imports, implementations, references, definitions and re-exports. Each call is linked to its definition only when the match is unambiguous, so the map leaves a link open rather than guessing it.
who: An architect who needs an accurate map of how a large codebase fits together
author: Corey James
